citationText: 14. For each tuple (param_name, param_value) of link_parameters: 1. If param_name matches "rel" or "anchor", skip this tuple. 2. If param_name matches "media", "title", "title*", or "type" and target_attributes already contains a tuple whose first element matches the value of param_name, skip this tuple. 3. Append (param_name, param_value) to target_attributes.
